frozen_execution_semantics.resource_lifetime: state first, data loader second, streaming one microbatch at a time
frozen_execution_semantics.rng: effective-step fold_in followed by deterministic micro-index fold_in
frozen_execution_semantics.optimizer: frozen AdamW from shared26 child; exactly one tx.update/apply_updates per effective batch
frozen_execution_semantics.ema: exactly once per effective optimizer update
frozen_execution_semantics.lr_schedule: advances once per effective optimizer update through frozen optimizer state

memory_implementation.micros_1_to_7: scaled micro-gradient accumulation with donated accumulator for micros after the first
memory_implementation.micro_8: last micro-gradient, accumulator addition, AdamW update and EMA update fused in one JIT with donated state and accumulator
memory_implementation.purpose: minimize simultaneous gradient/update-tree residency on one A100-80GB
